newsitem.title: UK: OPEC basket price rose 39 cts to $17.56 last week.
newsitem.headline: OPEC basket price rose 39 cts to $17.56 last week.

text.p: The price of OPEC's basket of seven crudes rose to $17.56 per barrel last week from $17.17 the previous week, the OPEC news agency OPECNA said on Monday.
Quoting figures released by the OPEC Secretariat, it said the price so far this year, up to April 24, has averaged $19.91 a barrel.
In March the basket price averaged $18.64, down from $20.48 in February and $23.19 in January, it said.
The basket comprises Algeria's Saharan Blend, Indonesia's Minas, Nigeria's Bonny Light, Saudi Arabia's Arabian Light, Dubai of the UAE, Venezuela's Tia Juana and Mexico's Isthmus.
